title: Record for "From cells to councils: a conservation law of allocation under scarcity"
description: The record behind the paper "From cells to councils: a conservation law of allocation under scarcity": paper and supplement drafts, the Persistence Allocation Model documents and their earlier versions, derived propositions with a numerical check, literature searches, natural-system checks, and two pre-registered held-out tests (H1, VitalDB; PT1, English local government) with their pre-registrations, analysis code, results, replications and blind adjudications. Extracted from the author's working repository with commit history and dates preserved; see README.md.
